_about: Alias -> model bindings for gx-cluster (D-030..D-034). Source of truth for the Control UI model cards and the Model Manager. Facts are from the pinned Hugging Face revision and live measurements (TEST_RESULTS.md section 18); runtime flags live in legenex/gateway/llama-swap/node0{1,2}.yaml, legenex/lifecycle/gx-max.conf and legenex/media/workflows/. Written by the Model Manager on assignment; reviewed in Git. Each alias's 'identity' block holds the verified facts about the repository it names; the Open WebUI identity sync (D-038) uses them only while identity.repository and identity.revision match the alias's current binding.

gx-mini.reasoning: thinking model; thinking disabled at the gateway for speed
gx-mini.startup: resident: preloaded when llama-swap starts, never unloaded (ttl 0)
gx-mini.measured: 52 tok/s decode, 0.1 s warm TTFT, vision and tool calls correct (2026-09-17)

previous.repository: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M GGUF (source repository not recorded in this project)
previous.status: superseded 2026-09-17; still on gx10-01 (3.2 GiB) as the rollback. Storage & Cleanup lists it for review

identity.derivation: a community fine-tune by HauhauCS (refusal removal, 'Aggressive' variant) of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
identity.weights: GGUF Q4_K_M quantized language model plus a BF16 vision projector (mmproj); not full precision
identity.modalities: text and image input, text output, tool calls
identity.verified: 2026-09-17: both sha256 values equal the Hugging Face LFS hashes at this revision; the running llama-server reports this model_path and 2 slots x 65536 tokens; the model card says 'Based on Qwen3.5-4B' and '4B dense parameters'

gx-fast.quantization: compressed-tensors: NVFP4 W4A16 routed experts, FP8 block attention and shared experts, BF16 vision tower
gx-fast.reasoning: thinking model; off by default at the gateway, on per request (reasoning_content)
gx-fast.startup: resident: preloaded with gx-mini (ttl 0); cold load about 4 minutes
gx-fast.memory: about 41-49 GiB on gx10-01; gx-mini + gx-fast leave 46-48 GiB MemAvailable
gx-fast.measured: 55 tok/s decode, 0.08 s warm TTFT, tool calls and vision correct (2026-09-17)

gx-max.runtime: SGLang (lmsysorg/sglang:dev-v4f-2dgx-v2), TP=2, nnodes=2, cookbook cell dgx-spark/flash-official/fp4
